title: Grilled Korean Beef Skewers with Hummus
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make recipe featuring marinated beef skewers grilled to perfection and served with a refreshing side of hummus. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner or outdoor barbecue.

ingredients.name: Korean beef (thinly sliced)
ingredients.notes: You can use flank steak or ribeye for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Hummus
ingredients.notes: Store-bought or homemade, whichever you prefer.

ingredients.name: Kissed sesame oil
ingredients.notes: For brushing the skewers during grilling.

ingredients.name: Skewers
ingredients.notes: Metal or bamboo, soaked in water for 30 minutes before use.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced and used in the marinade.

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and sesame oil to make the marinade.
Add the sliced beef to the marinade and mix well to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated beef onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with sesame oil to prevent sticking. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, prepare the hummus by stirring in chopped parsley. Serve the grilled skewers with a side of hummus for a refreshing and flavorful meal.
To serve, garnish the skewers with additional parsley and serve immediately.
